newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bufete up on hopes of Mexico energy boom.
newsitem.headline: Bufete up on hopes of Mexico energy boom.

text.p: Hopes that Mexico's energy sector will enjoy a boom in 1997 drove up the price of builder Bufete Industrial shares on Tuesday in the Mexican bolsa and New York.
Just before the close of trade, Bufete was at 52.60 pesos, up 10.27 percent. Its highest closing price in the last 12 months was 51.50 pesos. In New York, its ADRs were up $1 at $19-7/8.
"It has been partly helped by the investments that were announced for the energy sector," said Alvaro Shiraishi, analyst at UBS Securities in New York.
The Mexican government has announced a huge increase in public investment in 1997, particularly in state oil company Petroleos Mexicanos.
On Monday, Energy Ministry officials said 68.697 billion pesos was earmarked for energy projects in 1997. Bufete has been an active bidder for government building contracts.
